name: kkskills-essentials
description: Generic, project-agnostic working skills (5) that self-improve over time: additive-changes and no-duplicate-docs feedback discipline, proactive task reminders, the Conventional Commits reference, and plan decomposition & orchestration (implement/test/review + deep-down debugging). This is the everyday half; nine situational skills (migrations, clean architecture, secrets, concurrency, timezones, MCP authoring, local-LLM selection, verify-with-real-data, the self-improve meta-skill) moved to kkskills-situational, which you enable when the work calls for them. Personal/project-specific skills live in kkskills-personal.
